articles.summary: SUFFOLK, Va., Aug. 26, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Hampton Roads based TowneBank (NASDAQ: TOWN) announced today that its Board of Directors declared its third-quarter shareholder cash dividend of $0.28 per common share payable on October 9, 2026, to shareholders of record on September 25, 2026. The amount and declaration of future cash dividends are subject to Board of Directors’ approval in addition to regulatory restrictions.
